title: Repair promotion bootstrap when rollback root already exists

implementation_summary.code_guard: In materialize_immutable_rollback_runtime, check if destination exists. If it is a directory matching destination path, root device/inode, head commit, tracked tree, accepted dev commit, and repository slug, verify its immutable snapshot (verify_immutable_snapshot) and reuse its CandidateRuntimeIdentity instead of failing.
implementation_summary.descriptor_binding: Path, device, inode, commit, tree, accepted dev commit, and repository slug are verified against descriptor-bound handles and path identities.
implementation_summary.test_coverage: Added unit tests covering: 1) exact destination path/device/inode match reuse with verify_immutable_snapshot, 2) same-SHA different-root rejection, 3) identity/cleanliness failure in existing destination rejection (verify_immutable_snapshot failure).
